lines.en: label kirinsoccer15:
scene kirinsitups1
I head over to the gym to see how soccer practice is going.
lines.zh: 我去体育馆看看足球训练进行得怎么样。

lines.en: Today, I am finally going to do my job as a coach and teach these girls the true meaning of sportsmanship.
lines.zh: 今天，我终于要做我作为教练该做的事了，教这些女孩体育精神的真正含义。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: I’m probably just going to stare at them and figure out why I have yet to open up a thigh massage stand in the corner of the room.
lines.zh: 我大概只会盯着她们看，然后琢磨自己为什么还没在房间角落开一个大腿按摩摊。

lines.en: {i}That{/i} is the life I was destined to lead. Not this life of...
lines.zh: {i}那{/i}才是我命中注定要过的人生。而不是这种……

lines.en: Of...
lines.zh: 这种……

lines.en: : Where even is everyone?
lines.zh: : 人都到哪儿去了？

lines.en: I reach into my pocket for my phone to see if I’m here too late, but just as my fingers find their way into my pocket, a familiar voice cries out from the opposite side of the gym.
lines.zh: 我伸手进口袋掏手机，看看自己是不是来得太晚了，但就在我的手指摸进兜里的那一刻，一个熟悉的声音从体育馆的另一头喊了出来。

lines.en: : Sensei! Come quick! Kirin is dying!
lines.zh: : 老师！快来！Kirin 要死了！

lines.en: : That can’t be true when this background music is so upbeat.
lines.zh: : 这不可能啊，这背景音乐这么欢快。

lines.en: : Background...music?...
lines.zh: : 背景……音乐？……

lines.en: if karinlied == False:
scene kirinsitups2
else:
scene kirinsitups3
I make my way over to Miku and Karin to see what all this commotion about Kirin dying is.
lines.zh: 我朝 Miku 和 Karin 走过去，看看 Kirin 要死了这阵骚动到底是怎么回事。

lines.en: But Kirin isn’t even here.
lines.zh: 可 Kirin 根本不在这儿。

lines.en: Oh no.
lines.zh: 哦不。

lines.en: Was I too late?
lines.zh: 我来得太晚了吗？

lines.en: : Where will she be buried?
lines.zh: : 她会被埋在哪儿？

lines.en: : Heck if I know. I say we just toss her into the nearest dumpster and set it out to sea.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。我说干脆把她扔进最近的垃圾桶，然后推到海上去。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine it would get very far before sinking.
lines.zh: : 我觉得它沉下去之前漂不了多远。

lines.en: : Then let’s just drop her out of an airplane and send her off with an even bigger splash.
lines.zh: : 那就把她从飞机上扔下去，溅起一个更大的水花送她上路。

lines.en: : Miku, what is wrong with you?
lines.zh: : Miku，你有什么毛病？

lines.en: : Pep talk! I’m tryin’ to whip her into shape.
lines.zh: : 打气啊！我在努力把她练出来。

lines.en: : If she thinks I’ll just get rid of her body when she dies, she’ll be more into...you know, not dying.
lines.zh: : 要是她觉得自己死了以后我会直接把她的尸体处理掉，她就会更想……你知道，不死。

lines.en: : I can’t wait to see this study posted in medical journals.
lines.zh: : 我已经等不及要看这项研究登上医学期刊了。

lines.en: : Can’t...go on!
lines.zh: : 撑不……下去了！

lines.en: Another familiar voice wraps around my ankles and crawls its way up my body, slithering into my ears like some sort of miniature snake.
lines.zh: 又一个熟悉的声音缠上我的脚踝，顺着我的身体爬上来，像一条迷你小蛇那样钻进我的耳朵。

lines.en: Basically, I hear Kirin.
lines.zh: 也就是说，我听见了 Kirin。

lines.en: That’s how a normal person would describe this.
lines.zh: 正常人就是会这么描述的。

lines.en: scene kirinsitups4
: Six-thousand-four...six-thousand...five!
lines.zh: : 六千零四……六千……五！

lines.en: : Woah! How’d she fit in an extra five-thousand-ninety in the time it took us to say hi to Sensei?!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！在我们跟老师打招呼这么点工夫里，她怎么多塞进去五千零九十个的？！

lines.en: : Kirin, stop! That’s enough!
lines.zh: : Kirin，停下！够了！

lines.en: : She’s just trying to make herself look cooler...
lines.zh: : 她只是想让自己看起来更酷……

lines.en: : Congratulations on six-thousand sit-ups, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你六千个仰卧起坐，Kirin。

lines.en: : Is this the same routine you used to get in shape for the beach?
lines.zh: : 这跟你在去海滩之前用来塑形的那套是一样的吗？

lines.en: scene kirinsitups5
: You mean when you...paid more attention to my sister than...you did to me?
lines.zh: : 你是说你……更关注我姐姐……而不是我的时候？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure all I did was compliment her.
lines.zh: : 我记得我明明只是夸了她几句。

lines.en: : If I remember correctly, I {i}definitely{/i} spent more time with you that weekend.
lines.zh: : 如果我没记错的话，那个周末我花在你身上的时间{i}绝对{/i}比她多。

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter if your...heart’s...not in it!
lines.zh: : 如果你的……心……不在上面，那就不算！

lines.en: : Says the girl who willingly signed away any claim on my heart to her roommate.
lines.zh: : 这话从一个自愿把对我心的所有权签字让给她室友的女孩嘴里说出来。

lines.en: : Hm? What’s all this talk about hearts?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你们在说什么心啊？

lines.en: : Kirin’s roommate's that creepy girl with the eyes that are all like “BA-BAM!” right?
lines.zh: : Kirin 的室友就是那个眼睛“吧——嘭！”的诡异女孩，对吧？

lines.en: : You’re really gonna give your heart to somebody like that?
lines.zh: : 你真要把心交给那样的人？

lines.en: if karinlied == True:
: Miku! Of course S...Sensei isn’t going to just...give his heart away...
lines.zh: : Miku！老……老师当然不会就这么……把他的心交出去……

lines.en: : He’s going to wait for the right person to come along and...and...
lines.zh: : 他会等到那个对的人出现，然后……然后……

lines.en: : Ahhh, never mind! It’s too embarrassing to think about!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊，算了！想起来太羞耻了！

lines.en: else:
: ...Karin?
lines.zh: : ……Karin？

lines.en: : Why are ya lookin’ all sad all of a sudden? You feelin’ okay?
lines.zh: : 你怎么突然看起来这么难过？你还好吗？

lines.en: : H...Huh?
: Oh. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我没事。

lines.en: scene kirinsitups6
: Hey...mind doing me a favor and...holding my legs still for a little while?
lines.zh: : 嘿……能帮我个忙，把我的腿按住一会儿吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think I have the willpower to do that in a safe-for-work way.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得我有那个意志力，能用一种全年龄安全的方式做到。

lines.en: : Then slide your head between 'em and let me squeeze it with my knees to stabilize myself.
lines.zh: : 那就把你的头滑到我两腿之间，让我用膝盖夹住它来稳住自己。

lines.en: : I have no idea how effective that will be, but it would be my pleasure.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那会有多有效，但我乐意之至。

lines.en: : Nobody is squeezing anybody’s head!
lines.zh: : 谁也不许夹任何人的头！

lines.en: : Kirin, if you’re not gonna take this seriously, I’m gonna have to figure out a way to {i}make{/i} you!
lines.zh: : Kirin，如果你不当回事，我就得想个办法{i}让你{/i}当回事！

lines.en: scene kirinsitups7
: I am...taking this seriously! Do you see how much I’m sweating?!
lines.zh: : 我……有……在当回事！你没看到我出了多少汗吗？！

lines.en: : It’s like...a fucking sauna in here! Isn’t a hundred enough?! That’s like...way above average!
lines.zh: : 这里简直像个他妈的桑拿房！一百个还不够吗？！那已经……远远超过平均水平了！

lines.en: : Karin and I both pumped out two-hundred without a problem at all.
lines.zh: : 我和 Karin 都一口气做了两百个，一点问题都没有。

lines.en: : You two are fucking mutants! I’m just a normal player! I’m not even that good!
lines.zh: : 你们两个是他妈的变异人！我只是个普通球员！我甚至没那么厉害！

lines.en: : Sensei! Coach! Glasses!
lines.zh: : 老师！教练！眼镜！

lines.en: : Glasses is not one of my titles.
lines.zh: : 眼镜不是我的头衔之一。

lines.en: : What do you want?
lines.zh: : 你想干嘛？

lines.en: : We need ya to step in and motivate Kirin.
lines.zh: : 我们想请你出马激励一下 Kirin。

lines.en: : Without your help, she’s gonna stay at the same level she is now for the rest of her life.
lines.zh: : 没有你的帮助，她这辈子都会停在现在这个水平。

lines.en: : We’re reinventing her!
lines.zh: : 我们在重塑她！

lines.en: scene kirinsitups8
: I...ngh...don’t want to be reinvented...
lines.zh: : 我……呃……不想被重塑……

lines.en: : Just let me practice...how I want to practice...
lines.zh: : 让我按我自己的方式……训练……

lines.en: : And how is that? By hanging out on your phone? Or spending the entire period talking to Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那是什么方式？抱着手机不放？还是整节课都在跟老师说话？

lines.en: : We let you slack off every weekend. At least put some effort in today.
lines.zh: : 每个周末我们都让你偷懒了。至少今天拿出点干劲来。

lines.en: : We’re really trying to-
lines.zh: : 我们真的很努力在——

lines.en: scene kirinsitups9
: SIX-THOUSAND-TWENTY!
lines.zh: : 六千……二十！

lines.en: : SIX-THOUSAND...TWENTY-ONE!
lines.zh: : 六千……二十一！

lines.en: : You’re still pretending you’re in the thousands? That’s just a waste of breath.
lines.zh: : 你还在装作自己在几千这个数量级？那纯粹是浪费力气。

lines.en: : YOU’RE A...WASTE OF BREATH!
lines.zh: : 你才是……浪费力气！

lines.en: : SIX THOUSAND...TWENTY-TWO!
lines.zh: : 六千……二十二！

lines.en: I watch as Kirin repeatedly pulls her body up, struggling harder each and every time.
lines.zh: 我看着 Kirin 反复把身体撑起来，一次比一次更吃力。

lines.en: Miku and Karin pay close attention to her, calling her out whenever she doesn’t rise all the way.
lines.zh: Miku 和 Karin 紧紧盯着她，只要她没完全起来就喊她。

lines.en: It must feel horrible to be in her shoes right now.
lines.zh: 现在站在她的立场上一定难受极了。

lines.en: Or, who knows? Maybe it feels good?
lines.zh: 或者，谁知道呢？也许感觉还不错？

lines.en: She’s finally the center of attention for once- something even I understand she always wants to be.
lines.zh: 她总算当了一回焦点——这点我倒是懂，她一直都想当焦点。

lines.en: But the attention isn’t exactly good this time.
lines.zh: 但这次的关注可不怎么美好。

lines.en: The spotlight shining on her flickers.
lines.zh: 打在她身上的聚光灯在闪烁。

lines.en: It distracts her.
lines.zh: 那让她分心。

lines.en: And, getting tired of the inconsistent light-
lines.zh: 然后，厌倦了这种忽明忽暗的光——

lines.en: She, too, burns out.
lines.zh: 她也熄灭了。

lines.en: scene black
: SIX THOUSAND...FORTY-NINE!
lines.zh: : 六千……四十九！

lines.en: : I’m done! I can’t do any more!
lines.zh: : 我不行了！再也做不动了！

lines.en: : Ahhh no! That’s such a weird place to stop!
lines.zh: : 啊不要！停在这个数字也太怪了吧！

lines.en: : Please do at least one more for all of our sakes.
lines.zh: : 拜托看在我们大家的份上，至少再做一个。

lines.en: : No! That’s it! I’m done!
lines.zh: : 不要！就这样！我不行了！

lines.en: Her arms go limp and her head falls down to rest in her hands.
lines.zh: 她的双臂软下来，头垂下去埋进手里。

lines.en: She’s bright red and drenched in the efforts of her hard work.
lines.zh: 她满脸通红，被自己的努力浸透了。

lines.en: I’m actually surprised that Miku and Karin were willing to push her this far when it’s clear that she’s at her breaking point.
lines.zh: Miku 和 Karin 明明看得出她已经到极限了，却还愿意把她逼到这一步，说实话我挺惊讶的。

lines.en: But I guess it makes sense.
lines.zh: 不过想想也说得通。

lines.en: It’s not just routine. It’s punishment.
lines.zh: 这不光是例行训练。这是惩罚。

lines.en: Like when a player makes a poor choice in a game and has to run extra laps at the next practice in order to make up for it.
lines.zh: 就像一个球员在比赛里做了糟糕的选择，下一堂训练课就得额外多跑几圈来弥补。

lines.en: Or other things that people who actually care about their jobs as team coaches force onto their players in the name of “improvement.”
lines.zh: 又或者是那些真的把自己教练工作当回事的人，以“提高”之名强加给球员的其他事情。

lines.en: How much do you need to hurt someone in order to improve them?
lines.zh: 你要把一个人伤得多深，才能让他进步？

lines.en: : Hah...hah...hah...
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : 老师……

lines.en: : Help me...up...
lines.zh: : 拉我……起来……

lines.en: Without looking toward Miku and Karin for approval (And also because I just feel bad for her in general) I reach down and grab Kirin’s hand, pulling her to her feet.
lines.zh: 我没去看 Miku 和 Karin 求她们同意（而且总的来说我就是单纯觉得她可怜），我伸手抓住 Kirin 的手，把她拉了起来。

lines.en: She winces in pain and clutches her stomach for a moment as she rises, but seems to be okay once she’s standing still.
lines.zh: 她站起来的时候疼得一咧嘴，捂了一下肚子，但站定之后看起来还好。

lines.en: scene kirinsitups10
: Hah...hah...hah...
: Do you think we might have...been a little too hard on her?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们是不是……对她太狠了点？

lines.en: : She’s not looking so great right now...
lines.zh: : 她现在看起来不太好……

lines.en: : What are ya talkin’ about? She looks fine! Just a little red. But it’s a nice color for her!
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？她看起来很好啊！就是有点红。不过这颜色挺适合她的！

lines.en: : Kill...me...
lines.zh: : 杀了我……

lines.en: : Kirin, maybe you should sit down for a second?
lines.zh: : Kirin，你要不要先坐一会儿？

lines.en: scene kirinsitups11
: I’m...fine! Just gotta...catch my breath!
lines.zh: : 我……没事！只要……喘口气就行！

lines.en: : Weren’t you just talking about how you wanted to call it quits like, a minute ago?
lines.zh: : 你一分钟前不是刚说你想收工了吗？

lines.en: : Maybe a break would-
lines.zh: : 也许休息一下会——

lines.en: scene kirinsitups12
: Oh, so now you’re on {i}their{/i} side as well? Figures.
lines.zh: : 哦，所以现在你也站到{i}她们{/i}那边了？果然。

lines.en: : Why do there have to be sides? I just don’t want you pushing yourself too hard.
lines.zh: : 为什么非要有阵营？我只是不想你逼自己逼得太狠。

lines.en: scene kirinsitups13
: Yeah, well...it’s a little too late for that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊……现在说这个有点太晚了。

lines.en: : I feel like I fell in a lake.
lines.zh: : 我感觉自己掉进湖里了。

lines.en: : But like, the lake was full of hot water that was also really sticky for some reason.
lines.zh: : 但就是，那个湖里装满了热水，而且不知道为什么还很黏。

lines.en: : Probably pollution.
lines.zh: : 大概是污染吧。

lines.en: : Save the whales. Stop littering.
lines.zh: : 救救鲸鱼。别乱扔垃圾。

lines.en: scene kirinsitups14
: There are whales in lakes?!
lines.zh: : 湖里有鲸鱼？！

lines.en: : How do they fit?!
lines.zh: : 它们怎么塞得进去？！

lines.en: : Miku...
lines.zh: : Miku……

lines.en: : I know your grades aren’t...the best. But please tell me that was a joke.
lines.zh: : 我知道你的成绩……不太好。但请告诉我那是在开玩笑。

lines.en: scene kirinsitups15
: Sensei...How come you never teach us about whales?
lines.zh: : 老师……你怎么从来不教我们鲸鱼的事？

lines.en: : Talk to Kirin. She’s the one who seems to care the most about them.
lines.zh: : 问 Kirin 吧。看起来最在乎鲸鱼的就是她了。

lines.en: scene kirinsitups16
: Kirin, how come you-
lines.zh: : Kirin，为什么你——

lines.en: : I don’t give a shit about whales, Miku. I’m exhausted from doing six thousand sit-ups and am just talking out of my ass.
lines.zh: : 我他妈才不在乎鲸鱼，Miku。我刚做了六千个仰卧起坐累得要死，只是在胡说八道而已。

lines.en: : Is it cool if I go take a shower to cool down?
lines.zh: : 我能去冲个澡凉快一下吗？

lines.en: : Oh...uhh...well, we’re still in the middle of practice...
lines.zh: : 哦……呃……嗯，我们训练还没结束……

lines.en: : But you {i}are{/i} kinda lookin’ a little worse for wear.
lines.zh: : 不过你看上去{i}确实{/i}有点狼狈。

lines.en: : I guess it’s okay. But you’ve gotta come back as soon as you’re done for our practice game.
lines.zh: : 我觉得可以吧。但你一洗完就得回来，我们还有练习赛。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. Whatever.
lines.zh: : 行行行。随便吧。

lines.en: : Can I take Sensei with me?
lines.zh: : 我能带老师一起去吗？

lines.en: if karinlied == False:
scene kirinsitups17
: Take him with you to...to the showers?! Why on earth would ya do that?!
lines.zh: : 带他一起……去淋浴间？！你到底为什么要那样？！

lines.en: : I’m not as flexible as you guys and can’t reach every part of my body.
lines.zh: : 我不像你们那么柔韧，身体的每个地方都够不到。

lines.en: : I need his help getting all of the places I can’t get to myself.
lines.zh: : 我需要他帮我洗那些我自己够不着的地方。

lines.en: else:
scene kirinsitups18
: Kirin! Again?
lines.zh: : Kirin！又来？

lines.en: : Take him with you to...to the showers?! Why on earth would ya do that?!
lines.zh: : 带他一起……去淋浴间？！你到底为什么要那样？！

lines.en: : I’m not as flexible as you guys and can’t reach every part of my body.
lines.zh: : 我不像你们那么柔韧，身体的每个地方都够不到。

lines.en: : I need his help getting all of the places I can’t get to myself.
lines.zh: : 我需要他帮我洗那些我自己够不着的地方。

lines.en: : Well, if that’s what must be done-
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果非得这么办的话——

lines.en: scene kirinsitups19
: Keep it in your pants, Coach! I ain’t tryin’ to have a scandal on my soccer team until at least senior year!
lines.zh: : 把裤子管好，教练！我的足球队可不想闹出丑闻，至少得等到高三再说！

lines.en: : We’ve got stuff to focus on until then!
lines.zh: : 在那之前我们有正事要忙！

lines.en: : Hey, I’m just trying to look out for my players the only way I know how.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我只是用我唯一会的方式照顾我的球员而已。

lines.en: : By bein’ a heckin’ perv and sneakin’ into the showers with ‘em?
lines.zh: : 靠当个彻头彻尾的变态、偷溜进淋浴间跟她们一起？

lines.en: : Yes. Exactly that.
lines.zh: : 对。就是这个。

lines.en: : So, now that we’ve all decided that this is okay-
lines.zh: : 那么，既然我们都已经决定这样没问题了——

lines.en: : We have not decided that! I’m the captain and I say no!
lines.zh: : 我们没有决定！我是队长，我说不行！

lines.en: : I also...say no...
lines.zh: : 我也……说不行……

lines.en: : I say yes, which brings us to two against two.
lines.zh: : 我说行，那就是二比二。

lines.en: : The only possible solution is that we all just take a shower together.
lines.zh: : 唯一的解决办法就是我们大家一起洗。

lines.en: : Except for Karin. She can wait out here since she always takes too long.
lines.zh: : 除了 Karin。她可以在外面等，因为她每次都洗太久。

lines.en: scene kirinsitups20
: Wha- I do not!
lines.zh: : 什么——我才没有！

lines.en: : I take just as long as you do!
lines.zh: : 我跟你花的时间一样长！

lines.en: : Okay fine, but you also use twice the amount of shampoo.
lines.zh: : 好吧，可你用的洗发水也是两倍。

lines.en: : I have twice the amount of hair!
lines.zh: : 我的头发也是两倍！

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t know if I want Sensei...seeing me...like that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不知道我想不想让老师……看到我……那样。

lines.en: scene kirinsitups21
: You {i}sure{/i} about that, Miku?
lines.zh: : {i}你确定{/i}吗，Miku？

lines.en: : Doesn’t it get your heart racing? Even just a little bit?
lines.zh: : 不会让你心跳加速吗？哪怕就一点点？

lines.en: : Of course it does!
lines.zh: : 当然会啊！

lines.en: : I know firsthand how big his thing is because I sat on his lap during Halloween. And if I ever saw it up close I'd-
lines.zh: : 我可是亲身知道他那东西有多大，因为万圣节的时候我坐过他腿上。要是我能近距离看到它，我早就——

lines.en: scene kirinsitups22
: Wait! I wasn’t supposed to say that!
lines.zh: : 等等！我不该说那个的！

lines.en: : Makoto told me to never talk about it again!
lines.zh: : Makoto 叫我永远别再提了！

lines.en: : How...big...what is?
lines.zh: : 他的……好大……什么？

lines.en: : His...bed?...
: Woah.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。

lines.en: : Kirin! Don’t tell Makoto I said that!
lines.zh: : Kirin！别跟 Makoto 说我说过那个！

lines.en: : Does he...maybe have a dog that’s...really big?
lines.zh: : 他是不是……也许养了条狗，那条狗……很大？

lines.en: : But...why would Miku sit on a dog?
lines.zh: : 可……Miku 为什么要坐在狗身上？

lines.en: : Something isn’t...adding up...
lines.zh: : 有点……对不上啊……

lines.en: scene kirinsitups23
: Did you like it?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢吗？

lines.en: : Wha-
: I mean...it was...fine!
lines.zh: : 我是说……那还……行吧！

lines.en: : I try not to think about it!
lines.zh: : 我尽量不去想它！

lines.en: : Because it gets you excited?
lines.zh: : 因为一想你就兴奋？

lines.en: : My little Miku is growing up so quickly~
lines.zh: : 我家的小 Miku 长得真快啊~

lines.en: scene kirinsitups24
: Okay! Everybody into the showers except Sensei!
lines.zh: : 好了！除了老师，大家都去洗澡！

lines.en: : He should stay out here and think of Makoto’s naked body instead of ours!
lines.zh: : 他该留在外面，去想 Makoto 的裸体，而不是我们的！

lines.en: : Bye, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 拜拜，老师！

lines.en: : Sorry~
lines.zh: : 抱歉~

lines.en: : Can’t say I didn’t try.
lines.zh: : 不能说我没试过。

lines.en: : I feel like you had the chance to be a lot more persuasive than you actually were.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你本来有机会比我实际做到的更有说服力一些。

lines.en: : Or maybe {i}Miku{/i} was my target all along?
lines.zh: : 或者也许 {i}Miku{/i} 从头到尾才是我的目标？

lines.en: : That’s-
: Bad! No!
lines.zh: : 不行！不行！

lines.en: : Everybody out! Practice is cancelled!
lines.zh: : 全都出去！训练取消！

lines.en: : A...chair?
lines.zh: : 一把……椅子？

lines.en: : Those can get pretty big...
lines.zh: : 那种东西可以挺大的……

lines.en: : That...yeah. That would make the most sense.
lines.zh: : 那……是啊。那最说得通。

lines.en: scene black
In the end, the three of them disappear into the showers and I’m left out in the gym with all of the girls I don’t know the names of.
lines.zh: 最后，她们三个消失在淋浴间里，只剩我一个人留在体育馆，身边全是我叫不出名字的女孩。

lines.en: None of them really pay any mind to me, so I wind up deciding to get on with my day before Miku and the Kandas come back.
lines.zh: 她们谁都没怎么理我，所以我决定趁 Miku 和神田姐妹回来之前，先去过自己的这一天。

lines.en: I think about apologizing to one of them through text for the disappearance, but-
lines.zh: 我本来想给其中一个人发条短信，为我的不告而别道个歉，但是——

lines.en: I’ve inadvertently stirred up enough trouble for the day and don’t want to make things any worse.
lines.zh: 我今天已经无意间搅起了够多的麻烦，不想再把事情弄得更糟。

lines.en: I’m sure they’ll understand.
lines.zh: 我相信她们会理解的。

lines.en: I’m quite good at disappearing once things aren’t about me anymore.
lines.zh: 一旦事情不再与我有关，我可是相当擅长消失的。

$ kirinsoccer15 = True
{i}Kirin’s affection has increased to [kirin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Kirin 的好感度提升到了 [kirin_love]!{/i}
